scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, capture receipts, and every receipt-listed screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; tools/autopilot/AUDIT.md read for category-audit context.
review_method.rendering: Every receipt-listed PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and full ItemBody was reviewed in the snapshot and compared with the byte-identical current source, assigned local HTML, capture receipt, and screenshot tiles.
review_method.boundary: No item, application, publication-status, or live-site edits; no builds, tests, gates, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only lane-05.md and lane-05.json were written.

diagram_candidates.kind: one-colour crystal graph with two connected components
diagram_candidates.rationale: The complete four-vertex tensor crystal and its decomposition are a particularly compact, graph-native example: the written statement already determines one three-vertex string plus one isolated vertex. A diagram could make the component split and tensor-rule output immediate, but the inline formulas and prose are mathematically complete.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw vertices v0 tensor v0 -> v1 tensor v0 -> v1 tensor v1 as one 1-colour string, and v0 tensor v1 as an isolated vertex. Label weights 2 lambda_1, 0, -2 lambda_1 on the chain and 0 on the isolated vertex; label (epsilon_1,phi_1) as (0,2), (1,1), (2,0), (0,0), respectively. Show no arrows incident to the isolated vertex. The arrows must follow the two-case rule in source lines 38 and 48; do not imply the diagram proves the module decomposition.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; exact arrows, invariants, and decomposition are already explicit in the statement and checked vertex by vertex in the proof.

existing_diagrams.review: The displayed crystal arrow chain b2 -> b1 -> b0 and its stated weights/invariants are rendered as inline math in the assigned tiles; no mismatch is visible.
The inline two-case operator formulas and textual component decomposition render legibly. They specify the single chain and isolated vertex consistently; no existing graphical diagram is present.

limitations: Local screenshot and HTML review only; no live routes or full mathematical correctness review.
